evidence.title: Throwing Muses
evidence.text: Throwing Muses is an alternative rock band formed in 1981 in Newport, Rhode Island, that toured and recorded extensively until 1997, when its members began concentrating more on other projects.

evidence.title: Throwing Muses
evidence.text: The group was originally fronted by two lead singers, Kristin Hersh, and Tanya Donelly, who both wrote the group's songs.

evidence.title: Throwing Muses
evidence.text: Throwing Muses are known for performing music with shifting tempos, creative chord progressions, unorthodox song structures, and surreal lyrics.

evidence.title: Throwing Muses
evidence.text: The group was set apart from other contemporary acts by Hersh's stark, candid writing style; Donelly's pop stylings and vocal harmonies; and David Narcizo's unusual drumming techniques eschewing use of cymbals.

evidence.title: Throwing Muses
evidence.text: Hersh's hallucinatory, febrile songs occasionally touched on the subject of mental illness, more often drawing portraits of characters from daily life or addressing relationships.

evidence.title: Whiskey Tango Ghosts

evidence.title: Belly (band)
evidence.text: Belly is an alternative rock band formed in Boston, Massachusetts in 1991 by former Throwing Muses member Tanya Donelly (who was also in The Breeders).

evidence.title: Belly (band)
evidence.text: The original lineup consisted of Donelly on lead vocals and guitar, Fred Abong on bass, and brothers Tom and Chris Gorman on guitar and drums respectively.

evidence.title: Belly (band)
